title: When not to use microservices
description: Learn about When not to use microservices. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **When not to use microservices** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with when not to use microservices.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of when not to use microservices
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding when not to use microservices is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with when not to use microservices, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
